title: First bands: Starlight Serenade and house parties
summary: He recalls his first band, its members, the two trumpets, playing house parties for small pay, and moving on to better outfits.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

First band, uh, well, I don't know, well, the, uh, Starlight Serenade. Uh-huh. Who was in that band?
Uh, Wilton Smith.

Wilton Smith. Yeah, Wilton Smith. Uh, Wilton Smith, uh, What dance band did he play? Saxophone. And, uh, little Pappy played drums. Yeah, Wilton Smith played drums. Ratliff. And who was in that band? Peter Pass was in that band.
And it all had two trumpets in that band.
Two trumpets.
In relation to Honor of the Pass?
